title: Special Order for Esquire Limo, LLC, ex parte. — Esquire Limo, LLC, ex parte. In re: Request for cancellation of LPSC No. 8165. THEREFORE, IT IS ORDERED LPSC No. 8165 hereby is, cancelled.
